title: Final Temperature
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the temperature of the earth, T_E, as 290 K.

title: Final Radiation Force
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly determine the radiation force on the earth, F_E, as 6 x 10^8 N.

title: Final Chondrule Force
description: Essential Criteria: The student must accurately find the force on the chondrule, F, as 1.7 x 10^-11 N.

title: Energy Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of energy conservation by equating the radiation received and emitted.

title: Radiation Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply the Stefan-Boltzmann law to calculate radiation from the sun and earth.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the equations for radiation force.

title: Neglecting Heat Sources
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must recognize the assumption of neglecting the earth's own heat sources.
